basic_details.job_title: KSMHA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Steno-Typist, Assistant, Office Attendant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Keralam State Mental Health Authority (KSMHA), Thiruvananthapuram, has invited applications for 9 posts on a one-year contract basis at the Mental Health Review Boards constituted under the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017: 2 Assistant, 3 Steno-Typist and 4 Office Attendant. Consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 20,280 to Rs. 34,180 depending on the post. The qualification ranges from 7th standard pass to any degree with computer knowledge. Applications on the prescribed form, with a demand draft, go by hand or post to the chosen Mental Health Review Board by 26 November 2026.

qualification.details: Type writing English and Malayalam lower (KGTE/MGTE) with computer word processing Shorthand English and Malayalam lower | The notice states the cut-off date for calculating age as 01.01.2026. An equivalency certificate of the respective University must be produced for any other degree to be considered against the notified degrees. The notice does not list a desirable qualification or experience requirement. For the exact eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form given on the KSMHA website, https://www.ksmha.org/. The form is also printed with the notice.

Attach an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), a passport size photograph taken within six months, copies of qualification certificates attested by a Gazetted officer, and copies of experience certificates.
SC/ST candidates claiming the fee concession attach a copy of their caste certificate.
Attach a demand draft for the fee, drawn in favour of the Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, payable at Thiruvananthapuram.
Seal the envelope securely and write on it: Application for the post of ........ at Mental Health Review Board, ........
Submit the application by hand or post to the Superintendent of the Mental Health Review Board of your choice, clearly stating the post and preferred centre, by 26 November 2026.

Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form for each post with a separate demand draft. Multiple applications supported by a single combined demand draft, or an insufficient fee, will be rejected without notice.

Attested copies of educational qualification certificates
Attested copies of technical qualification certificates, if applicable

important_instructions: Candidates must give a working email address, contact number and communication address, as further procedures are intimated by email or post. Any discrepancy found during detailed scrutiny will result in rejection of candidature. content_sections.heading: About KSMHA
content_sections.text: The Keralam State Mental Health Authority is constituted as per the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, and its office is at Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram. The posts are for the Mental Health Review Boards constituted under the same Act. The notice is dated 10.11.2026 and is signed by the Chief Executive Officer.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 9 vacancies in total, by post and by centre. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is a consolidated monthly amount, quoted in the notice with G.O. (P) No.24/2026/Fin dated 18.02.2026. The appointment is purely on contract basis, and the period of contract for all posts is one year. The notice names no allowances.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says a detailed scrutiny of applications and credentials will be conducted before interview or appointment. Selection norms will be as applicable for contract posts in the Government of Keralam. With the approval of the Government of Keralam, KSMHA reserves the absolute right to shortlist candidates for interview based on merit, to conduct an independent screening test and skill test, or to delegate the entire recruitment process to a government-approved testing agency, depending on the total volume of applications. The decision of the Government and KSMHA is final and binding. Candidates will be intimated by email or post about further procedures. The notice prints no interview or test date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSMHA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 2 Assistant, 3 Steno-Typist and 4 Office Attendant, spread over the Thiruvananthapuram, Kottayam, Thrissur and Kozhikode Mental Health Review Boards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSMHA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for KSMHA Assistant, Steno-Typist and Office Attendant?
faq.answer: Assistant needs any degree with computer knowledge. Steno-Typist needs SSLC pass with typewriting (English and Malayalam lower, KGTE/MGTE, with computer word processing) and shorthand English and Malayalam lower. Office Attendant needs 7th standard pass.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for KSMHA posts?
faq.answer: All three posts have an age limit of not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. For Steno-Typist, retired State/Central Government employees may be not more than 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200 per post, and Rs. 100 for SC/ST candidates, paid by demand draft in favour of the Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, payable at Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for KSMHA posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 34,180 for Assistant, Rs. 24,590 for Steno-Typist and Rs. 20,280 for Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for KSMHA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from the KSMHA website, attach the CV, photograph, attested certificates and demand draft, and submit by hand or post to the Superintendent of your chosen Mental Health Review Board by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KSMHA job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, and the period of contract for all posts is one year.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but each post needs a separate application form and a separate demand draft. Multiple applications with one combined demand draft, or an insufficient fee, are rejected without notice.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications go through detailed scrutiny. KSMHA may then shortlist candidates for interview based on merit, conduct a screening test and skill test, or delegate the process to a government-approved testing agency, depending on the volume of applications.
